ideas.pitch: An AI-powered agricultural supply chain risk and fair-pricing platform using graph intelligence and local market data to protect smallholder farmers from middlemen exploitation.
ideas.title: KrishiGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Agriculture and FinTech domains highlighted in the hackathon description while utilizing the graph intelligence and AML/risk detection patterns proven successful in Bito.

ideas.pitch: A localized, voice-activated clinical query assistant tailored for rural Indian healthcare workers, combining offline-first multilingual speech-to-text with Llama-based medical RAG protocols.
ideas.title: MediSutra RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the Healthcare domain and leverages the high-accuracy voice-RAG pattern validated by Voz-AI.

ideas.pitch: An automated industrial environmental compliance monitor that analyzes open-source satellite imagery to detect unauthorized deforestation and industrial waste dumping near protected zones.
ideas.title: EcoSat Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Environment & Sustainable Development track by applying the exact satellite monitoring pattern that won runner-up at Xcelerate Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace for freelance Indian educators and content creators featuring automated escrow payouts on crypto rails to guarantee project completion.
ideas.title: SkillEscrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines EduTech and Web3 & Blockchain domains while reusing the successful autonomous agent and escrow payment patterns from Dispatch.

ideas.pitch: An automated micro-lending credit scoring copilot that evaluates alternative data such as utility payments and local business inventory to underwrite loans for unbanked micro-entrepreneurs.
ideas.title: MicroCred AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the FinTech domain by implementing an explainable AI business strategy platform pattern seen in Astropreneur and Bito.
